description: SimWalk offers pedestrian simulation products for buildings, transport facilities and airports. The provider distinguishes its Transport, Airport, PRO and 360 products. Users supply the space and movement assumptions to examine congestion and evacuation. The product family is a reusable commercial environment; individual scenario results depend on calibration and do not follow from the product description alone. Published by SimWalk. Spatial and temporal resolution are source-dependent; any detail not stated above remains unknown. Access is through the provider documentation and software links; no software was installed. Reuse licence: Commercial SimWalk licence. Software access is paid under the provider’s terms. Potential simulation uses include emergency response, resilience. Related catalogue records: model-pathfinder-thunderhead-egress. These are contextual links, not a claim of a tested integration.
